retrievalProfile.description: A symmetrical one-point perspective composition featuring a receding colonnade of classical pillars leading toward a central horizon light source.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic landscape defined by a central path flanked by two rows of Corinthian-style columns that diminish in size toward a bright vanishing point on the horizon, set against a warm orange-to-purple gradient sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical alignment of pillars along a central axis
Contrast between dark foreground silhouettes and bright horizon light
Scale progression from large foreground elements to microscopic distant points
Integration of a solitary figure to establish human scale
coreInvariants: One-point perspective vanishing at the center horizon
Warm sunset color palette with high-contrast shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small solitary figure is positioned in the lower third, centered on the path, appearing tiny against the massive architecture.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vanishing point where the path and pillars converge at the horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large foreground pillars, follows the path inward to the horizon, then moves upward to the large display typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky area in the upper half provides breathing room for large-scale text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep orange and amber (sky and horizon light)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and black (shadows and silhouettes)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted purple and red (upper sky and text outlines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation at the horizon fading into darker, desaturated tones in the foreground shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy, chiseled serif forms with metallic textures
Central character integrated with a circular/phi symbol
High-contrast outlines in red or bright tones
characterSpecificRedesigns: Central glyph features a vertical bar intersecting a circle, mimicking a Greek Phi symbol
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy metallic display type at the top paired with widely spaced, delicate serif type at the bottom.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical Roman proportions match the architectural theme.
Small serifs and wide stance provide a similar display feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal landscape with a central road flanked by two rows of classical Corinthian columns receding into a bright sunset horizon. Include a small silhouette of a person walking away on the road. Use a warm orange and dark brown color palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large beveled metallic serif text at the top center, incorporating a circular symbol in the middle. Add small, widely spaced serif text at the very bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the central symbol vertically aligned with the vanishing point?
Does the bottom text have extreme letter spacing?
Is the color palette dominated by sunset gradients?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the metallic bevel effect on display text
Ensure the figure is small enough to convey scale
Confirm the horizon is the brightest point of the image
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical Colonnade + Sunset Gradient + Metallic Serif Display Type
